verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a headless mode for Letta Code designed to run non-interactively in scripts/CI/CD pipelines, plus an --ephemeral one-shot mode, and this was independently confirmed by a runtime probe successfully invoking the CLI keylessly. The App Server also supports headless self-hosted deployment for automation. Missing for 10: no third-party CI pipeline case study or public CI config example beyond docs/probe.
